第1章 黑子的篮球一
【初到黑篮】
“律，别忘了自习之后要训练啊。”
微笑着应下的原田律内心却是无比泪流，天知道自己虽然对于篮球很热爱尤其是帅哥很多很养眼，他自己却不愿意运动的啊…>
话说自己来到这个世界已经有一个月了呢。
趴在桌子上被阳光照的有些懒洋洋的律迷迷糊糊的回想着一个月之前的事情。自己处于即将从a大医学院毕业的时期，由于成绩的优异从而早就已经得到省医院的工作名额，所以在别人为了毕业和工作而焦头烂额的时候，他却是极为轻松的窝在家里。不过自己可一点也不无聊，因为托自己表妹的福，他在两年前就迷上了动漫。虽然一开始因为对动漫的印象停留在无限粉红泡泡的少女漫上所以极不情愿，但当看过几集之后便彻底抛开了那种偏见，投入其中不可自拔。
原田律本名林笑，他的表妹梅浅是一个不折不扣的动漫迷加腐女，除了yy美型的人物之外，最喜欢的就是拿林笑和别人凑作堆。
每次遇上这种情况，林笑也不急，只是斜着眼瞄她。
“没钱妹妹这么关心你哥我的终身幸福啊哥哥好感动~”
某只一听这外号立刻炸毛，将她之前说的都抛向了九霄云外。
“你才没钱，你全家都没钱！”
“貌似咱俩是一家的？啊咧，没钱妹妹这么急着要我陪你同甘共苦啊~”
“口胡！谁要你和我同甘共苦…啊呸，谁说我苦了？”
林笑眼一眯，笑眯眯地伸出手揉揉她黑亮蓬松的头发，“没钱妹妹不苦，有我这么好的哥哥别人羡慕还来不及怎么会苦呢，明明是世界上最幸福的孩子嘛~”
梅浅嘟囔着自恋狂什么的倒也不再炸毛。
总之，林笑很喜欢和这个妹妹在一起。
至于为什么林笑会变成原田律，那么不得不说，有的时候，狗血来的就是那么简单。
林家是医药世家，自然有自己的药房，而梅浅虽说是自己的表妹却又不性林，所以梅浅并不懂药理。那天太忙了让梅浅来帮忙的林笑，就因为梅浅拿错了药而在试药时中毒身亡。
当林笑醒来时他本以为自己没有死，却在听到那个冰冷机械的声音时打消了这个念头。
“随机穿越系统已启动，请玩家完成系统任务，完成后可获得相应奖励和点数。主线任务一旦失败玩家将永久消失，支线任务一旦失败将由系统给予相应惩罚。”

林笑有点发蒙的听着，刚想问些什么就失去了意识。
再醒来时，便到了另一个世界。通过脑海中传来的记忆，他现在是帝光中学一年生，姓名原田律。接收完一大堆零零散散的记忆后，他已经知道他在哪个世界了。
黑子的篮球。
自己第一部看过的动漫诛天邪帝。就是因为这部动漫让自己踏入了动漫这个新领域。
正想着自己还不知道要有什么任务时，脑海中便传来了机械的声音，“世界1：黑子的篮球，主线任务，进入帝光中学篮球部，与黑子哲也成为朋友并成为正选。随机任务通过玩家随机触发。”
原田律听完之后只想喷他一脸血，当朋友还比较现实而且自己也很乐意，但那个成为正选是什么啊，让自己在帝光成为正选简直是不可能的啊，要知道一个篮球队一共才五个主力七个替补，至于主力那是想也不要想，毕竟奇迹的时代可是最强的存在，而且————最关键的是，以前因为自己懒，从小到大自己几乎一到体育课就会请假偷懒，篮球什么的，真是只停留在知道要把球投进去这种浅显的层面上啊…
可是系统已经告诉过他了，一旦失败，等待着他的就是永远消失。
抿紧了唇，原田知道自己的时间不多，因为时间也只有三年，但其实自己如果不在前两年成为正选的话，第三年也就不可能了吧。
那么自己首先要看看自己这副身体素质怎么样。
不得不说原田长得很好看，精致的眉眼和五官，栗色的头发看上去很柔软，又因为换成了林笑的灵魂而褪去了这个年龄应有的浮躁，显得很温和，整个人给人一种舒服的感觉。
身材匀称但让他很郁闷的并不算高，大概只有一七几的样子，看起来有些有些瘦弱。
原田（现在开始叫这个名字了呢）叹了口气，先天条件就不能在意这么多了，现在当务之急是要马上开始练习打篮球。
本来情绪还有些低落的原田打算出门转一转却惊喜的看到了一抹天蓝色的身影。虽然说黑子时刻都在使用misdirection，但他却很奇怪的不受影响。于是他追了上去，轻轻拍了下黑子的肩膀。
黑子回过头，目光中带着明显的惊讶和一丝迷茫，歪头道，“嗯？你是…”
原田在心里已经被萌的不行了，面上露出一个温和友好的笑容。
“请问你是一年b组的黑子哲也吗？”
见黑子点了点头，原田笑着伸出手，“我是一年a组的原田律，很高兴认识你。”
显然黑子对于人际交往并不在行，也没大有人能发现他而主动向他表示友好，因此有些不自然的伸手和他握了握，声音不大却很清晰。“你好，原田君。”
原田笑眯眯地诱拐，“黑子在这里做什么呢？”
黑子也不在意原田的自来熟，很是礼貌的回答道，“去练球。”

原田两眼放光，“啊，黑子一定很厉害吧！我可不可以去看一看呢？”
黑子只是有些奇怪，倒也不觉得有什么不行，便点点头，“如果原田君想的话，不过我打的并不好。”
对于小黑子老实的回答感到很是愉快的原田摇摇头，“黑子太谦虚了呢，我知道黑子是与众不同的哦。而且我一点也不会呢，所以麻烦黑子多教教我啦。”
黑子歪歪脑袋，“那我们走吧，就在不远的地方。”
安静的跟在黑子身后，原田突然感觉这样很好，黑子的性格他很喜欢，走在一起的时候感觉很舒服。
“就是这里。”
听到黑子的声音，原田环顾了一圈，这个篮球场不大却比较新，也没有别人，安安静静很适合练习。

Chapter 1 Kuroko’s Basketball 1
[First time at Black Basket]
"Ritsu, don't forget to train after your self-study."
Harada Ritsu smiled and agreed, but his heart was full of tears. God knows that although he loves basketball very much, especially because there are many handsome guys who are eye-catching, he himself is not willing to exercise...>
It has been a month since I came to this world.
Lying on the table and being illuminated by the sun, Lu was lazily thinking about what happened a month ago. He was about to graduate from the medical school of University A. Due to his excellent grades, he had already obtained a job in the provincial hospital. Therefore, while others were struggling for graduation and work, he was extremely relaxed at home. But he is not bored at all, because thanks to his cousin, he became obsessed with anime two years ago. Although I was very reluctant at first because my impression of anime was limited to girl comics with infinite pink bubbles, but after watching a few episodes, I completely put aside that prejudice and became obsessed with it.
Ritsu Harada's real name is Lin Xiao, and his cousin Mei Qian is an out-and-out anime fan and fujoshi. Apart from the yy-looking characters, her favorite thing is to make fun of Lin Xiao and make fun of others.
Whenever encountering this kind of situation, Lin Xiao was not in a hurry and just glanced at her sideways.
"My poor sister cares so much about your brother and my lifelong happiness. I'm so touched by you~"
When a certain girl heard this nickname, she immediately became furious and threw everything she had said before out of the window.
"You don't have any money, your whole family doesn't have any money!"
"It seems like we are from the same family? Ah, my poor sister is so anxious for me to accompany you through thick and thin~"
"You're talking nonsense! Who wants you to share the joys and sorrows with me...ah, who said I'm suffering?"
Lin Xiao narrowed his eyes and stretched out his hand to rub her black and fluffy hair with a smile, "Sisters who have no money don't have to suffer. How can I suffer if I have a good brother like me who is too late for others to envy him? He is obviously the happiest child in the world~"
Mei Qian muttered about being a narcissist, but she didn't get angry anymore.
In short, Lin Xiao liked being with this sister very much.
As for why Lin Xiao became Ritsu Harada, then I have to say that sometimes, it's so simple to be so cruel.
The Lin family is a medical family and naturally has its own pharmacy. Although Mei Qian is his cousin, she is not Lin, so Mei Qian does not understand pharmacology. Lin Xiao, who was too busy that day and asked Mei Qian to help, was poisoned and died during the test because Mei Qian took the wrong medicine.
When Lin Xiao woke up, he thought he was not dead, but gave up the idea when he heard the cold mechanical voice.
"The random traversal system has been activated. Players are asked to complete system tasks. After completion, they will receive corresponding rewards and points. Once the main task fails, the player will disappear permanently. Once the side task fails, the system will impose corresponding punishments."
Lin Xiao listened in a daze, and just as he was about to ask something, he lost consciousness.
When I woke up again, I was in another world. Through the memories that came to his mind, he was now a first-year student at Teiko Middle School, named Ritsu Harada. After receiving a lot of scattered memories, he already knew which world he was in.
Kuroko's basketball.
The first anime I ever watched was Evil Emperor Zhutian. It was because of this anime that I stepped into the new field of animation.
Just when I was thinking that I didn't know what mission I was going to have, a mechanical voice came from my mind, "World 1: Kuroko's Basketball, main mission, enter Teiko Middle School Basketball Club, become friends with Kuroko Tetsuya and become the main selection. Random missions are randomly triggered by players."
After hearing this, Harada Ritsu just wanted to spit blood on his face. Being friends is more realistic and he is happy with it, but what is becoming the main selection? It is simply impossible for him to become the main selection in Teiko. You must know that a basketball team only has five main players and seven substitutes. As for the main players, don't even think about it. After all, the era of miracles is the strongest existence.And————the most important thing is that because I was lazy in the past, I would take time off almost as soon as I got to physical education class to be lazy. When it comes to basketball, it really only stays at the superficial level of knowing how to throw the ball in...
But the system has told him that once he fails, what awaits him is to disappear forever.
Pursing his lips, Harada knew that he didn't have much time, because it was only three years, but in fact, if he didn't become the main candidate in the first two years, it would be impossible in the third year.
Then you must first take a look at your physical fitness.
I have to say that Harada is very good-looking, with delicate eyebrows and facial features, and chestnut hair that looks very soft. And because he has been replaced by Lin Xiao's soul, he has lost the impetuousness that should be expected at this age and looks very gentle. His whole person gives people a comfortable feeling.
He has a well-proportioned figure, but what makes him depressed is that he is not very tall. He is only about 17 or more years old, and he looks a little thin.
Harada (who is now called by this name) sighed, he couldn't care so much about his innate conditions, the top priority now was to start practicing basketball immediately.
Harada, who was still a little depressed, planned to go out for a walk, but was surprised to see a sky-blue figure. Although Heizi was using misdirection all the time, he was strangely unaffected. So he chased after him and gently patted Kuroko on the shoulder.
Heizi turned around, with obvious surprise and confusion in his eyes. He tilted his head and said, "Huh? Are you..."
Harada was already extremely cute in his heart, and a gentle and friendly smile appeared on his face.
"Are you Kuroko Tetsuya from the first-year team B?"
Seeing Kuroko nodding, Harada smiled and stretched out his hand, "I am Ritsu Harada from the first-year group A. Nice to meet you."
It was obvious that Heizi was not good at interpersonal communication, and not many people could find him and take the initiative to express friendship to him, so he stretched out his hand unnaturally and shook hands with him, the sound was not loud but very clear. "Hello, Harada-kun."
Harada smiled and asked, "What are Kuroko doing here?"
Kuroko didn't care about Harada's familiarity and replied politely, "Go practice."
Harada's eyes shone, "Ah, Kuroko must be very powerful! Can I go and take a look?"
Kuroko was just a little strange, but he didn't think there was anything wrong with it, so he nodded, "If Harada-kun wants to, I'm not good at fighting."
Harada, who was very happy with Kuroko's honest answer, shook his head, "Kuroko is too humble. I know Kuroko is different. And I don't know how to do it at all, so please teach me Kuroko."
Heizi tilted his head, "Then let's go, it's not far away."
Following Kuroko quietly, Harada suddenly felt that this was good. He liked Kuroko's character very much and felt very comfortable when walking together.
"This is it."
Hearing Kuroko's voice, Harada looked around. The basketball court was small but relatively new. There were no other people around, so it was quiet and suitable for practice.
